# `SkyReplay`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of the sky replay recorder (firmware 9.75).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ; envelope INFERRED |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.75, resolver reports, skyReplayFunc @0x1d1bb0, printSkyReplayState @0x1d3700 (64-bit build) |

New in firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0. The function name is SkyReplay and the worker sends function-state events (READ). The initial state string is idle and the other is recording. The feature is force-disabled in firmware 9.75 (the enable getter always reports false and the setter clears the stored flag), so whether any event is emitted on a real device is unresolved. Session cap: 600 frames. The envelope is the shared function-state envelope (INFERRED). A receiver MUST NOT depend on seeing any transition.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"SkyReplay"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name; INFERRED to follow the shared function-state formatter. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [INFERRED] |
| `wide_cam` | boolean | no | - | Added with a non-null callback context (firmware 9.75, both builds). [READ] |
| `camera_id` | integer | no | - | Camera the session records (value meaning INFERRED). [READ; meaning INFERRED] |
| `recorded_frame_count` | integer | no | - | Frames recorded so far in the session. [READ] |
| `video_frame_count` | integer | no | - | Frames in the video being built. [READ] |
| `output_file` | string | no | - | Conditional; present with a non-null callback context unless a filename-suppression flag is set, whose runtime meaning is unresolved (firmware 9.75, both builds). [READ (conditional); flag meaning unresolved] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, example - INFERRED envelope, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"SkyReplay","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","camera_id":0,"recorded_frame_count":12,"video_frame_count":12}
```
